    StartersSpice-roasted chickpeasCrunchy chickpeas roasted with cumin, smoked paprika and cinnamonHow to make it800g chickpeas2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp smoked paprika1/2 tsp ground cinnamonDrain and dry the chickpeas well.Toss with the oil, the cumin, the smoked paprika, the cinnamon and salt.Roast at 200°C for 35 minutes, shaking twice, until crunchy.Cool 5 minutes before serving.Sietch Tabr stuffed desert datesMedjool dates filled with goat's cheese and almond, honey drizzleHow to make it16 medjool dates100g goat's cheese16 almonds2 tbsp honeySplit the medjool dates and remove the stones.Fill each with a little goat's cheese and a toasted almond.Lay on a plate and drizzle with the warm honey just before serving.Sietch flatbread with date butterBread in the deep desert sietchHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft yoghurt flatbreads blistered in a dry pan, brushed with butter whipped with Medjool dates, cardamom and flaky salt.Mix 300g self-raising flour, 250g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and rest 15 minutes.Divide into 8 and roll thin.Cook in a very hot dry pan 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered.Blitz 100g soft butter with 4 pitted Medjool dates, a pinch of ground cardamom and a pinch of salt until smooth.Brush over the hot breads, sprinkle with flaky salt and tear to share.Baba ghanoush with pomegranateStilgar sees a sign. 3.5 hours until it pulls apart.Steep a pinch of saffron in hot water and cook the basmati rice with it until golden and fluffy.Fremen spiced red lentil stewThe Fremen making every drop of water in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes.Add 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp coriander for 1 minute.Stir in 300g rinsed red lentils, 400g tinned tomatoes and 1L vegetable stock and simmer 25 minutes, stirring, until thick.Add the juice of 1 lemon and salt.Melt 40g butter with 1 tsp chilli flakes and cumin seeds until sizzling, pour over and top with
